families.name: Button
families.description: A named task operation.
families.domainBoundary: Solid destructive appears only at the final confirmation scope.

families.name: IconButton
families.description: Compact, clearly named utility action.
families.domainBoundary: Do not put critical meaning solely in an icon or tooltip.

families.name: TextLink
families.description: Navigate to a real destination or related record.
families.domainBoundary: Use a button instead when the action changes current data.

families.name: MenuItem
families.description: A single command or destination within a menu.
families.domainBoundary: Each menu follows one compatible keyboard model.

families.name: TextInput
families.description: Single-line editable text with persistent label.

families.name: TextArea
families.description: Multi-line reason, note or message.
families.domainBoundary: Do not silently truncate clinical or policy text.

families.name: SearchField
families.description: Filter or search a named collection.
families.domainBoundary: Clear query restores the unfiltered state; no-results differs from empty collection.

families.name: Select
families.description: Choose one known option.

families.name: Combobox
families.description: Search and select patient, service or staff option.
families.domainBoundary: No patient creation from a typo without explicit review; do not expose unauthorized patient results.

families.name: PhoneField
families.description: Phone details with country prefix and formatting.
families.domainBoundary: Format does not prove phone ownership or delivery availability.

families.name: AmountField
families.description: Enter money with explicit configured currency.
families.domainBoundary: Discount/rounding/tax rules are supplied; retain original entry on validation failure.

families.name: NumberField
families.description: Quantity or threshold with unit and validation.
families.domainBoundary: Consumer defines integer/decimal/min/max rules and rounding; quantity missing is not zero.

families.name: DateField
families.description: Typed calendar date with optional picker.
families.domainBoundary: Parsing must not silently swap day/month; clinic timezone is visible when it affects booking.

families.name: TimeField
families.description: Typed or selected time within configured rules.
families.domainBoundary: Do not silently accept impossible or conflicting times.

families.name: ColorInput
families.description: ColorInput for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: FileUpload
families.description: Select and review an allowed attachment.
families.domainBoundary: Consumer supplies storage, size/types, privacy, retention, scan status and upload authority; local preview is not persisted upload.

families.name: OtpInput
families.description: Verify a code in a future account or booking flow.
families.domainBoundary: One actual field supports paste/autofill. Verification service, timeout and account policy not supplied by source.

families.name: FormActions
families.description: Reviewable final actions and dirty-state feedback.
families.domainBoundary: Safe discard requires defined draft scope; unknown result checks authority before resubmission.

families.name: Checkbox
families.description: Independent binary setting or selection.

families.name: RadioGroup
families.description: One selection from a visible related set.

families.name: Switch
families.description: Apply an immediately understood on/off setting.
families.domainBoundary: For consent or a final form submission use a checkbox or explicit submit flow instead.

families.name: SegmentedControl
families.description: Choose one calendar or data presentation mode.
families.domainBoundary: Use radio-group semantics when choosing a value, tabs only when switching panels.

families.name: Tag
families.description: Chosen filter/category with optional removal.

families.name: MultiSelect
families.description: Select multiple compatible services, tags or supplies.
families.domainBoundary: Consumer validates service compatibility and total duration, not this visual primitive.

families.name: NavItem
families.description: NavItem for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: AppSidebar
families.description: Role-specific navigation with workspace identity.
families.domainBoundary: Role-specific visibility follows supplied permission facts; hiding a nav item does not enforce access.

families.name: TopBar
families.description: Current context, search, notifications and account.

families.name: Tabs
families.description: Switch among related panels without losing context.

families.name: Breadcrumb
families.description: Location within record/settings hierarchy.

families.name: Pagination
families.description: Navigate a known result collection.
families.domainBoundary: Unknown totals stay unknown; changing filters resets stale pagination appropriately.

families.name: Stepper
families.description: Show named stages and allow safe return.
families.domainBoundary: Back preserves entries; completed appearance does not claim external booking completion.

families.name: BottomNavigation
families.description: Phone client navigation for persistent destinations.
families.domainBoundary: Use only real destinations; no redundant tab set for a short linear booking flow.

families.name: AccountMenu
families.description: Account, role and session operations.
families.domainBoundary: Source roles are demo/simulated; actual authentication is a consumer integration.

families.name: NotificationMenu
families.description: NotificationMenu for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: Accordion
families.description: Accordion for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: SectionHeader
families.description: A clear group title and scoped action.

families.name: InlineAlert
families.description: Persistent contextual information requiring awareness.

families.name: Toast
families.description: Nonblocking operation feedback.
families.domainBoundary: No irreversible task or critical error depends only on a disappearing toast; undo scope must be real.

families.name: EmptyState
families.description: A collection with no items yet.
families.domainBoundary: Different from filtered no-results or a failed load.

families.name: NoResults
families.description: Search/filter returned zero matches.

families.name: Skeleton
families.description: Static placeholder matching actual expected structure.
families.domainBoundary: Never keep stale placeholders after failure; no decorative shimmer required.

families.name: Progress
families.description: Known activity or completion measurement.
families.domainBoundary: Unknown progress is indeterminate, never a fabricated percentage.

families.name: ErrorState
families.description: ErrorState for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: UnknownState
families.description: UnknownState for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: PermissionState
families.description: Denied, restricted or expired access without data leakage.

families.name: FormErrorSummary
families.description: FormErrorSummary for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: Dialog
families.description: Focused decision or form over current context.
families.domainBoundary: Safe initial focus on destructive confirmation; Escape cannot imply cancellation after external execution.

families.name: Drawer
families.description: Narrow-screen modal detail or task context.
families.domainBoundary: Modal drawer manages focus; docked desktop panel does not trap focus.

families.name: DropdownMenu
families.description: DropdownMenu for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: Tooltip
families.description: Brief nonessential label or clarification.
families.domainBoundary: No required information, errors or interactive content solely in tooltip.

families.name: Popover
families.description: Anchored temporary supporting controls.

families.name: Avatar
families.description: Person or clinic identity without decorative stock photos.
families.domainBoundary: Do not fabricate staff/client identity; patient photo usage follows consent and access policy.

families.name: Badge
families.description: Short count or supplemental noninteractive metadata.
families.domainBoundary: Badge is not a universal status primitive; do not omit object meaning.

families.name: StatusChip
families.description: Object-specific readable status with optional icon.
families.domainBoundary: Status families may share appearance, not state semantics. See domainStateModel.

families.name: TableRow
families.description: TableRow for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: DataTable
families.description: Aligned operational records with real column semantics.
families.domainBoundary: On phone switch to clear record rows where two-dimensional comparison is unnecessary; no nested card per row.

families.name: Metric
families.description: Named metric with timeframe, unit and context.
families.domainBoundary: A click is not completion; source/denominator and collected vs earned revenue stay distinct.

families.name: Chart
families.description: Accessible summary paired with underlying data.
families.domainBoundary: No fabricated trends. Color encodings include labels/shape and a data equivalent.

families.name: Timeline
families.description: Time-ordered history with actor and outcome.
families.domainBoundary: Timestamped entry is evidence of a recorded event, not proof of delivery or consent.

families.name: DescriptionList
families.description: Structured label/value details.
families.domainBoundary: Missing value shows an explicit unknown/missing label, not zero.

families.name: CalendarToolbar
families.description: Date navigation, jump, view and practitioner filtering.

families.name: CalendarEvent
families.description: Time-proportional appointment with readable facts.
families.domainBoundary: Height represents duration; appointment past time does not imply completed; selection preserves status color.

families.name: CalendarGrid
families.description: Time/date schedule with nonoverlapping event placement.
families.domainBoundary: List/agenda is keyboard and phone alternative. Drag is optional and requires non-drag equivalent.

families.name: AgendaRow
families.description: Phone/compact next-appointment scanning.

families.name: DatePicker
families.description: Navigate dates and choose an eligible date.
families.domainBoundary: Typed date is an alternate path; unavailable dates explain their reason where known.

families.name: TimeSlot
families.description: Select one eligible clinic-local appointment start.
families.domainBoundary: Chosen slot is not yet reserved. Refresh stale availability before final commit.

families.name: AppointmentPreview
families.description: Review selected appointment without leaving schedule.
families.domainBoundary: Desktop pane is nonmodal; narrow modal restores focus on close.

families.name: BookingRequest
families.description: Pending patient booking request and safe decision.
families.domainBoundary: Accept requires authoritative availability and permissions; pending request is not confirmed calendar event.

families.name: AttendanceControl
families.description: Record arrival separately from booking confirmation.
families.domainBoundary: Check-in does not start a clinical session or mark payment received.

families.name: BlockedTime
families.description: Protect a real interval and explain calendar conflicts.
families.domainBoundary: No silent appointment cancellation when working hours or blocks change.

families.name: ServicePicker
families.description: Choose service and variant with known duration and price.
families.domainBoundary: Preparation/cleanup and compatibility are consumer scheduling rules, not guessed by component.

families.name: BookingReview
families.description: Review all booking facts before final submission.
families.domainBoundary: Receipt, payment and confirmed appointment remain independent; visible sample prices are labeled demo.

families.name: RescheduleReview
families.description: Review old/new appointment interval and consequences.
families.domainBoundary: Preserve appointment identity/history and resolve any financial/reminder outcomes separately.

families.name: CancellationReview
families.description: Confirm named appointment cancellation and verified consequences.
families.domainBoundary: Cancellation does not itself establish refund or notification delivery. Safe initial focus keeps appointment.

families.name: PatientSummary
families.description: Identity and minimum task-relevant clinical context.
families.domainBoundary: Reception variant excludes medical file contents; actual authorization required.

families.name: ClinicalReview
families.description: Readiness checks before care.
families.domainBoundary: Submitted intake is not reviewed; review completion is explicit and attributed.

families.name: MedicalRecord
families.description: Clinical information sections with controlled access.
families.domainBoundary: No unapproved diagnosis/medical advice; record content and policy are supplied.

families.name: SessionControl
families.description: Start, maintain and finish authorized care session.
families.domainBoundary: Source limits start to confirmed current-day appointment and one active session; consumer validates policy before execution.

families.name: ClinicalNote
families.description: Capture and review a draft note without false signing.
families.domainBoundary: Signed/amended records follow clinical policy; visual save cannot claim legal signature.

families.name: ConsentSummary
families.description: Show exact consent state and approved document reference.
families.domainBoundary: Do not generate legal consent wording or infer acceptance from navigation.

families.name: TreatmentConsumption
families.description: Review supplies consumed in a session before stock update.
families.domainBoundary: Suggested service supplies are not automatically verified consumption; stock and clinical facts update independently.

families.name: ServiceOutcome
families.description: ServiceOutcome for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: Aftercare
families.description: Aftercare for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: MessageComposer
families.description: MessageComposer for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: PriceLine
families.description: Named price/fee/discount with configured currency.
families.domainBoundary: From price displays variant dependency; do not invent tax or discounts.

families.name: BalanceSummary
families.description: Invoiced/paid/remaining facts with explicit scope.
families.domainBoundary: Future uninvoiced services do not automatically become outstanding debt.

families.name: PaymentMethod
families.description: Select a supported real or explicitly simulated method.
families.domainBoundary: Component lists methods from configuration; no implied live gateway integration.

families.name: PaymentCapture
families.description: Review amount/method and record authoritative result.
families.domainBoundary: Do not claim payment received from UI completion; demo action must remain labeled simulated.

families.name: InvoiceSummary
families.description: Break down fees and receipts for one invoice.
families.domainBoundary: Invoice is distinct from appointment and transaction records.

families.name: RefundReview
families.description: Show requested/refundable amount and separate refund state.
families.domainBoundary: Source reception explicitly restricts refunds; business rules/provider authority are external.

families.name: FinancialRecordRow
families.description: Trace earned revenue versus collected receipts.
families.domainBoundary: Metrics distinguish earned service revenue, net receipts including deposits, and outstanding delivered-service balance.

families.name: Discount
families.description: Discount for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: SupplyCard
families.description: Item catalog identity and editable properties.

families.name: StockRow
families.description: Editable quantity, threshold, expiry and condition.
families.domainBoundary: Expired is not available-for-use merely because quantity is positive.

families.name: VariantCount
families.description: Reconcile physical stock across tracked variants/batches.
families.domainBoundary: Do not replace missing count with zero; preserve units and batch/expiry association.

families.name: StockHistory
families.description: Auditable inventory change and scoped reversal.
families.domainBoundary: Source Undo limited to last inventory edit until next save; history entry preserves reversal rather than silent deletion.

families.name: WorkSchedule
families.description: Working days, hours, breaks and conflict review.
families.domainBoundary: Schedule changes flag affected reservations; no silent cancellation.

families.name: StaffPermissions
families.description: Review permissions and nondelegable restrictions.
families.domainBoundary: Consumer supplies policy. Source A receptionist restrictions are observed prototype rules, not a universal security model.

families.name: ProfileForm
families.description: Edit doctor or clinic identity/contact.
families.domainBoundary: Saved local form does not prove public profile publication or verified credentials.

families.name: BookingPolicies
families.description: Display/edit approved booking policy values and text.
families.domainBoundary: Do not invent deposit, cancellation, age, consent or refund policy; retain version/effective scope.

families.name: DataBackup
families.description: Explain storage scope and export selected records.
families.domainBoundary: Source is browser-local demo. Export does not prove remote backup, synchronization or recoverability.

families.name: ServiceEditor
families.description: ServiceEditor for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: NotificationPreferences
families.description: Control optional appointment communication.
families.domainBoundary: Message preference is not actual message delivery or marketing consent; integrations and legal text supplied.

families.name: ServiceCard
families.description: Readable service discovery for customers.
families.domainBoundary: Use actual descriptions; do not invent benefits, safety or medical claims.

families.name: PractitionerCard
families.description: Choose available clinician from verified profile facts.
families.domainBoundary: No invented credentials, reviews or portraits; photographs require source permission.

families.name: BookingProgress
families.description: Keep client-oriented booking sequence visible.
families.domainBoundary: Receipt and confirmed booking have different final screens if approval is required.

families.name: AvailabilityPanel
families.description: Show real dates/times and support no availability.
families.domainBoundary: No fabricated scarcity/countdown; recheck after stale data or submission conflict.

families.name: BookingDetailsForm
families.description: Collect minimum details needed for booking.
families.domainBoundary: Do not collect full medical history merely to reserve time unless required and justified.

families.name: PolicyDisclosure
families.description: Make real costs/terms clear before commitment.
families.domainBoundary: Acknowledgment is explicit, not prechecked; approved policy source and version supplied.

families.name: BookingOutcome
families.description: Explain request receipt, confirmed booking or unknown outcome.
families.domainBoundary: Never say confirmed while waiting for approval or payment status that controls booking. Unknown gives check-status path.

families.name: MyAppointment
families.description: View and safely manage own appointment.
families.domainBoundary: Identity verification, scope of visible clinical details and reschedule/cancel policy are consumer responsibilities.

families.name: ClinicContact
families.description: Verified practical clinic information.
families.domainBoundary: Only show real supplied contact/location; no fabricated maps or phone destination.

families.name: ClientReceipt
families.description: ClientReceipt for its recorded Clinime task.

families.name: IntakeReadiness
families.description: Show pre-visit tasks without implying clinical approval.
families.domainBoundary: Completion means the named administrative task, not fitness for treatment.

sourceSync.iconMaster: NONE layout;24px SVG at0,0 with SCALE constraints; semantic glyph/ordinal swap keys preserve distinct state icons.
sourceSync.button: Main Button has AUTO width/min184, optional Show icon BOOLEAN on regular primary icon variants, and a fixed busy spinner without swap or visibility binding.
sourceSync.runtimeStateLimit: The library supplies reusable visual families and critical outcome specimens. Do not claim every possible runtime state combination or fullRTLvariants have been implemented.
sourceSync.iconSwap: Property key includes semantic source glyph name + ordinal, preventing variant combination from coercing one glyph into another. Busy spinner has no INSTANCE_SWAP or optional visibility binding.
sourceSync.calendar: Both month grid and date picker use actual Monday-start dates 28Sep–1Nov2026, all31October days, correct Thu1/Wed28; selected cell only, out-of-month muted.
sourceSync.focusV4: Twelve native focus states are applied; legacy full renderer alone does not reproduce the external focus ring. See build/focus-states-v4.js.

rebuildEvidence.historicalEvidence: evidence/pre-rebuild contains prior391-variant ledgers; those IDs are obsolete for the current Components file.
